name: Integrated Social Security Scheme: Pension to Physically Challenged Persons
briefDescription: Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹1,000/- is provided to poor physically handicapped persons (including those who are blind, deaf, or dumb) with a degree of disability 40% or above and having no source of income.
descriptionMd: The scheme &quot;Pension to Physically Challenged Persons&quot; is a sub-component of the “Integrated Social Security Scheme (IGSSS)” implemented by the Social and Tribal Welfare Department, Administration of Union Territory of Ladakh. Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹1,000/- is provided to poor physically handicapped persons (including those who are blind, deaf, or dumb) with a degree of disability 40% or above and having no source of income.
benefitsMd: **Amount of pension:**  ₹1,000/- per month per beneficiary
eligibilityMd:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of the Union Territory of Ladakh.
   1. The applicant should be a physically challenged person with a disability of 40% or more (including Blind, Deaf, Dumb).
   1. The applicant should belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
   1. The applicant&#39;s age should be between 18 and 79 years.
   1. The applicant should have no source of income.
applicationMd:
> **Registration Process:**

**Step 1:** Visit the ‘[Ladakh E-Seva Platform](https://eseva.ladakh.gov.in/ladakheservices)’ and navigate to the “Go Live Services” tab on the right side of the screen. Select the ISSS scheme under the &#39;Social Welfare&#39; section.
**Step 2:** Click on the &#39;[Registration](https://eseva.ladakh.gov.in/cznregistration)&#39; tab in the right corner of the screen. 
**Step 3:** Read the instructions carefully and fill in all the required information accurately. Upload the Passport-size scan photo (jpg image) in a clear background of size less than 50 kB. 
**Step 4:** Note the User ID and Password after successful registration for future reference.
> **Login to apply for scheme benefits:**

**Step 1:** To apply under the scheme, visit the ‘[Ladakh E-Seva Platform](https://eseva.ladakh.gov.in/ladakheservices)’ again and navigate to the “Go Live Services” tab on the right side of the screen. Select the ISSS scheme under the &#39;Social Welfare&#39; section.
**Step 2:** Enter your [login](https://eseva.ladakh.gov.in/indexpage) credentials (Login ID and Password generated after registration), select &quot;User Role&quot; as &quot;Citizen,&quot; enter the Captcha, and click on &quot;Submit&quot;. 
**Step 3:** After Login, the applicant has to click on the “E-services” tab in the left menu.
**Step 4:** Click on the “Department of Social &amp; Tribal Welfare” and select the scheme ‘Pension to Physically Challenged Persons’ under “Integrated Social Security Scheme”.
**Step 5:** Fill in the required details accurately and upload the mandatory documents then click on Submit to complete the application process.
